payload.source_label: Hyperbolic equations with variable coefficients may not be in conservation form

contract.statement: Within the book's first-order hyperbolic setting, equations with variable coefficients need not be in conservation form. The selected clause asserts this possibility without specifying a counterexample or a criterion excluding all alternative representations. Conservation form is contextualized by the flux PDE (1.8) and the interval balance (1.10). The book restricts its discussion to first-order hyperbolic systems. [Raw PDF page 25, printed page 3, paragraph following equation (1.7).]
